title: Isolated pilot of rinadelph/Agent-MCP outside the tracked repository tree
objective: Owner-directed: pilot https://github.com/rinadelph/Agent-MCP (AGPL-3.0) to evaluate it as a possible future replacement for the current file-based .ai/state/tasks coordination protocol. Per the owner's explicit choice, this pilot must not touch anything the existing protocol, guard, or other agents (Codex, Gemini) depend on. All clone/install/run activity happens entirely under the session scratchpad, outside the tracked Grafting Monorepo tree; this task record exists only to satisfy the coordination guard's Bash gate, since none of the real work touches repository-tracked files.
validations: Cloned rinadelph/Agent-MCP (--depth 1) entirely under the session scratchpad, outside the tracked Grafting Monorepo tree
Built and ran the agent-mcp-node (TypeScript) implementation: npm install, npm run build, then CI=true npm run server -- --port 4400 --mode full --project-dir <scratchpad>
Server came up for real: GET /health and /stats both returned live JSON confirming 39 registered tools across all 10 categories, sqlite-vec vector search enabled, SQLite schema initialized

Confirmed via the server's own log that OpenAI-based RAG is inactive without OPENAI_API_KEY (expected, flagged in advance); every other category (agent/task management, file locking, messaging, session state) reports enabled
Nothing under the tracked Grafting Monorepo tree was touched by this pilot; .ai/state/tasks, the guard, and PROTOCOL.md are unchanged
artifacts: Ephemeral: Agent-MCP clone and running server instance live only under the session scratchpad, not part of the tracked repository
risks: Agent-MCP is AGPL-3.0; fine for internal/local use, but network-hosting a modified version for others would trigger its source-disclosure obligation. Not a concern for this local pilot.
Its RAG/shared-memory feature requires an OPENAI_API_KEY; without one, only the non-memory parts of the pilot (agent/task creation, dashboard, file locking) can be demonstrated.
This pilot intentionally does not touch .ai/state/tasks, tools/scripts/agent-task-guard.mjs, or .ai/coordination/PROTOCOL.md; nothing here changes how Codex or Gemini coordinate today.
No screenshot capability is available in this environment (confirmed earlier this session); the demo is verified via direct HTTP/API calls against the running local server, not a visual screenshot.
